not_found: This farmer is not in the register.
title: Confirmation of farm registration
body: We confirm that {name}, phone {phone}, from {place}, has been registered in the Jutyar farm register since {since}, with {n} farm(s) covering {area} dunam in total, as listed below.
name: Name
no_farms: No farm is registered for this farmer yet.
unit_note: 1 dunam = 2,500 m². Areas and crops are as the farmer registered them in the Jutyar app.
purpose_ph: For example: a loan from the agricultural bank, a seed or fertilizer programme, an insurance claim
closing: This letter is given at the farmer's request. It confirms the registration only; it is not a proof of land ownership.
check: To check this letter, call {phone} and give the letter number {no}.
